reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00403750 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403750-GOActiveMission.cpp at sha256 f2b34605e968ad20a89d225e7ea4f056dc501af4fea1bf4b0c6ea31c18f9f611 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOActiveMission(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

divergences: Frame pointer read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].
Script_EvalArgInt receives the argc word as its frame.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00403750 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403750-GOActiveMission.cpp (sha256 f2b34605e968ad20a89d225e7ea4f056dc501af4fea1bf4b0c6ea31c18f9f611). Single block 0x403750-0x4037B5: EAX=Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0); g_bc2384[g_bc2380*0x159]=EAX; memcpy([E+4],{0,0,0,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return [E+4].

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail reads the frame from [E+0xc]; BN models (int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc). The candidate int32_t GOActiveMission(int32_t param_1, float param_2) puts param_2 at [E+8], the argc slot.The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00403750; radare2 recovers "fcn.00403750 (int32_t arg_24h_2, int32_t arg_24h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00403750 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOActiveMission(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
